timeline.text: Welcome to Awake in the Middle of the Night. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am awake and I do not want to be.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am worried about how little sleep I will get.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I keep wondering why I woke up.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind wants to solve this right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels alert in the middle of the night.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am frustrated that I cannot force sleep.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me keeps monitoring the time.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel restless.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This wake-up is starting to feel like a problem.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let being awake be neutral for a moment.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not have to calculate the night.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can stop searching for a reason right now.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Rest can happen even before sleep returns.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to soften in the dark.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can release the effort to force sleep.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: The clock does not need my attention.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can let this be a quiet pause.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make room for drowsiness to return.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am safe to rest again.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My body knows what to do with this night.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can let thoughts pass without joining them.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I welcome heaviness into my body.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My breath can become slower and easier.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need to make sleep happen.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I trust rest to return in its own time.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: This wake-up does not define tomorrow.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to drift back toward sleep.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
